description: This file defines a C# controller class 'TagsController' for handling HTTP requests related to tags in an ASP.NET Core application. It uses MediatR for mediating requests and is part of the 'Conduit.Features.Tags' namespace.

classes.name: TagsController
classes.description: A controller class for managing tag-related API endpoints, including a GET method to retrieve tags.
